# Jambh Electricals

## About
Jambh Electricals is a trusted electrical shop and electrician service provider based in Lilas, Haryana, India. We serve Lilas, Sainiwas, Siwani, Hisar, and nearby areas. We offer complete electrical solutions including house wiring, fault repair, MCB RCCB installation, LED lighting, fan repair, inverter service, motor repair, and sell all electrical products and accessories.

## Location
- Address: Lilas, Haryana, India
- Primary Base: Lilas
- Service Areas: Lilas, Sainiwas, Siwani, Hisar, Tosham, Bhiwani, Hansi, Barwala, Agroha, Adampur, and nearby villages
- State: Haryana
- Country: India

## Services
- House Wiring and Rewiring (new wiring, concealed wiring, surface wiring, villa wiring, flat wiring, office wiring)
- Electrical Fault Finding and Repair (short circuit, power trip, MCB tripping, RCCB tripping, current leakage, earth leakage, phase problem, neutral fault)
- MCB RCCB Installation and Repair (MCB replacement, RCCB installation, ELCB, isolator, changeover, distribution board, DB box, electrical panel)
- LED Light Installation and Repair (LED bulb, tube light, panel light, ceiling light, wall light, decorative lighting)
- Ceiling Fan Repair and Installation (fan wiring, fan regulator, fan capacitor, exhaust fan, wall fan)
- Inverter and UPS Repair (inverter battery, battery replacement, power backup, Microtek inverter, Luminous inverter)
- Water Motor and Pump Repair (submersible pump, pump installation, motor rewinding, motor wiring)
- Switch and Socket Repair (modular switch, switch board, socket installation, plug point, power socket)
- Emergency Electrician Service (24 hour electrician, electrical emergency, power failure)
- Electrical Safety Inspection (electrical maintenance, electrical upgrade, load extension, meter installation)
- Commercial and Industrial Electrical Services (shop wiring, factory wiring, electrical contractor)
